recognize_zh: 周邊血液中多個中到大型原始細胞，核質比高、核圓形、染色質細緻，胞質深藍色並常有一側較淡的核周區域，未見 Auer 小體或顆粒；單看型態無法判定系別，需靠流式確認為 B/骨髓系混合表型急性白血病。
features: Medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio
Round to slightly indented nuclei with fine, dispersed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Scant to moderate deeply basophilic cytoplasm, often with a paler perinuclear or polar zone
No visible cytoplasmic granules or Auer rods
Background red cells with occasional echinocytes (crenated forms); no platelets evident in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio, round to slightly indented nuclei, fine chromatin and scant to moderate deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm with a paler perinuclear zone. No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules are identified. Background red cells show occasional crenated forms. The blasts are morphologically undifferentiated and lineage cannot be assigned on morphology alone; in conjunction with flow cytometry the findings are consistent with mixed phenotype acute leukemia, B/myeloid.

ddx.vs: Morphology is indistinguishable; B-ALL lacks MPO expression or monocytic differentiation by flow cytometry and cytochemistry.

ddx.dx: AML with minimal differentiation or without maturation
ddx.vs: Morphologically similar agranular blasts, but separation requires demonstrating absence of B-lineage commitment (strong CD19 with CD79a/CD22/CD10).
Monoblasts have more abundant, often vacuolated grey-blue cytoplasm and folded nuclei with prominent nucleoli, and are nonspecific esterase positive.

ddx.dx: Reactive large granular or activated lymphocytes
ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have more mature, clumped chromatin and abundant cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells, rather than fine blast chromatin.
